job.title: Delivery Executive SAP CX (human)
job.email_subject: Application: Delivery Executive SAP CX – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

SAP CX delivery needs someone who speaks both business and platform – I have delivered SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 / 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell
– SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User

I know delivery from the inside – planning, releases on CCv2 and production support – and coordinate smoothly across international teams. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP CX Delivery | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert, Techno-Functional | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP CX professional with 5+ years delivering enterprise B2B and B2C commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Combines stakeholder management, requirements engineering, solution design and UAT with deep platform know-how in OCC APIs, OMS, Promotions and PIM / ERP / MDM integration. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performs code reviews and guides junior developers in international, agile delivery teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: All for One is a leading SAP partner, and SAP CX delivery is where my experience sits: five years of SAP Commerce Cloud projects for Rockwell Automation and Shell, from requirements and integrations to releases and production. I want to bring that delivery know-how to your clients in the DACH region.

en.subject: Application: Delivery Executive SAP CX
en.hook: Delivering SAP CX projects successfully depends on people who understand both the client's business and the platform in depth. That is my profile: for more than five years I have turned business requirements into working SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell – certified as SAP Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

bullets.label: Client & stakeholder focus
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Complex integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Delivery quality & team guidance
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production issues and provided technical guidance to junior developers; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved system stability and data consistency.

en.logistics: I know delivery from the inside – planning, releases on CCv2 and production support – and coordinate smoothly across international teams. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
